title: Introduce compliance-mode toggle, RBAC dry-run explainability, and KMS failover simulator
author: Sofia Ramirez
release_notes: Add an opt-in 'compliance mode' for staged RBAC v2 enforcement, per-tenant audit sampling overrides, and a KMS failover simulator for validating cross-region key fallback behavior. No user-visible API breaking changes.
description:
Context and motivation: Several customers asked for a safer path from RBAC v2 'dry-run' to 'enforce' while maintaining explainability for denials, plus operational tooling to validate KMS region fallback behavior during upgrades. This PR adds a runtime 'compliance_mode' toggle (cluster-scoped, opt-in per-namespace), structured explain logs for RBAC dry-run, per-tenant audit-sampling overrides, and a lightweight KMS failover simulator useful in staging and upgrade runs.

What this changes (high level):
- runtime: introduce config flag 'compliance_mode' and a fast-path guard that flips middleware semantics (dry-run -> annotated-enforce) without requiring immediate policy rewrites
- rbac: add rbac/v2: ExplainableDecision annotations emitted when dry-run evaluates to deny; new endpoint /admin/rbac/explain that returns recent explain traces for a principal (TTL-limited)
- audit: per-tenant sampling override via AdminConfig (applies to hosted & dedicated) and an in-process sampler that marks sampled events with sampling_reason for downstream processors
- kms: tools/kms/failover-sim: small simulator that exercises configured KMS endpoints in order of affinity, forcing fallback to secondary regions and emitting metrics the console can visualize
- ui: admin console toggle and a short how-to linking to operational runbooks

Checklist:
- [x] compliance_mode runtime flag and guard
- [x] RBAC explain log format + /admin/rbac/explain endpoint
- [x] per-tenant audit sampling override config + default backfill for existing tenants
- [x] KMS failover simulator (binary + small harness)
- [x] unit & integration tests; CI job updated
- [x] docs: docs/operational/compliance-mode.md and UI help text

Commits (summary):
- commit 1: feature: add compliance_mode config, middleware changes, tests
- commit 2: feat(rbac): emit ExplainableDecision annotations and admin explain endpoint
- commit 3: feat(audit/kms): per-tenant sampling overrides + kms failover simulator + docs and UI tweaks

Changed files (high level):
- cmd/compliance-toggle/main.go (new)
- pkg/rbac/v2/middleware.go (modified)
- pkg/rbac/v2/explain_store.go (new)
- pkg/audit/sampler.go (modified)
- tools/kms/failover-sim/runner.go (new) and README.md (new)
- ui/admin/compliance-settings.tsx (modified)
- docs/operational/compliance-mode.md (new)
- tests/integration/compliance_mode_test.go (new)

Testing and CI: Initial CI run caught a lint failure in middleware.go and a flaky integration test (timing). Addressed lint and added a small backoff in the integration harness; reran CI -- final status: pass. Unit coverage for changed packages is 86% (local measurement). e2e run in staging exercised KMS failover simulator against a two-region test KMS and validated metrics/alerts.

Review conversation (condensed):
- Aisha Khan (reviewer): "Nice approach. Two asks: (1) make the explain store TTL configurable and bounded, and (2) ensure explain payloads redact tenant-sensitive fields before they're persisted."
  - Author (Sofia): "Addressed: explain_store now accepts ttl override via admin config, and redact logic centralised into pkg/audit/redactor.go; added unit tests."
- Luca Moretti (reviewer): "Simulator is useful — please ensure it cannot be enabled accidentally in production; should be behind a feature gate and RBAC-protected."
  - Author: "Simulator binary is gated by cluster feature flag and admin RBAC check; added guard in the installer and UI hides toggle unless the cluster flag is set."
- Jemal Okoye (reviewer): "Audit sampling changes — please include migration notes for tenants with custom retention, and call out observability changes."
  - Author: "Added migration steps to docs/operational/compliance-mode.md and added new metrics (audit.sampler.override.count and audit.sampler.default.count) to the console metrics catalog."

Final approvals: Aisha Khan approved; Luca Moretti approved after minor tweaks; Jemal Okoye approved.

Merge outcome: PR was merged via squash merge on 2024-11-27 after CI passed. Change set was small and non-breaking; a feature gate is required to enable compliance_mode in production.

Operational notes and follow-ups:
- Ops runbook: how to flip a tenant from dry-run to enforced is documented with a suggested 7-day canary window and recommended audit sampling (10% -> 100%) for the canary period.
- Follow-up: ENG-8215 to extend explain traces to include policy lineage (owner/team) and ENG-8216 for a self-service simulation endpoint for tenant admins.

Related work: Linear ENG-8142 (staged RBAC enforcement), PM-4021 (customer ask: safer enforcement path), and ENG-8215/ENG-8216 for follow-ups.
notes: This PR is intended to provide a safer migration path for customers moving from RBAC dry-run to enforced mode, while giving ops and SRE tools to validate KMS and audit behavior before drift is enabled broadly. The feature gate prevents accidental production enablement.
changelog_short: Add cluster compliance_mode flag; RBAC explainability logs; per-tenant audit-sampling overrides; KMS failover simulator; admin UI toggle and docs.
